title: Pulp & Paper
summary: Pulp and paper companies use PI System for production models, control-loop monitoring, energy buy-versus-generate decisions and water planning. Mills combine many areas, from woodyard to paper machine, in one data model.
hierarchy:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  C[Company] --> M[Mill]
  M --> A1[Woodyard]
  M --> A2[Digester and Fibreline]
  M --> A3[Bleaching]
  M --> A4[Recovery Boiler]
  M --> A5[Power and Steam Plant]
  M --> A6[Paper Machine]
  M --> A7[Water and Effluent]
  A2 --> CL[Control Loop]
```

tags.name: PV
tags.description: Process value of a control loop.

tags.name: OP
tags.description: Controller output of a control loop.

tags.name: Mode
tags.description: Control loop mode, such as manual or automatic.

templates.name: Control loop
templates.description: Control loop element for loop performance monitoring (Ence built its tool from AF and event frames).

calculations.name: Time in manual
calculations.expression: Time the loop Mode is manual over a period
calculations.description: One way to find poorly performing loops in control-loop monitoring. Illustrative.

eventFrames.name: Poor loop performance
eventFrames.trigger: A control loop performs poorly (for example oscillation or time in manual)

kpis.name: Pulp production (ADt/year)
kpis.definition: Air-dry tonnes produced; Klabin reported +3,400 air-dry tons per year.

kpis.name: Renewable energy share
kpis.definition: Share of total energy from renewable sources; Sappi states over 80 percent.

kpis.name: Energy saved per mill
kpis.definition: Energy saved, in MWh; Ence reported 1,500 MWh per pulp mill.

pitfalls: Without integrated models, evaluating a proposed production change can take hours (Klabin).
Without visibility of energy data, buy-versus-generate decisions cannot be optimised (Sappi).
verifyNote: The mill AF hierarchy, control-loop attributes and the time-in-manual calculation are inferred. Paper-machine KPIs (basis weight, moisture profiles, breaks, machine efficiency) were not found in a readable source.
